title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
title_zh: ZeroVLN：无需对 VLM 大脑进行监督微调的导航学习
abstract_en: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.
abstract_zh: 典型的视觉语言导航（VLN）方法将视觉语言模型（VLM）作为大脑，与可学习的动作头结合，并在导航领域数据上对 VLM 进行监督微调（SFT），使其预测几何目标。然而，这种适配可能显著改变 VLM 的权重，损害其通用视觉能力。ZeroVLN 提出一种快慢双层导航框架，无需对 VLM 大脑进行导航领域的 SFT。VLM 不再直接预测几何目标，而是通过语义工具调用接口，以自然语言向动作专家下达移动指令。训练首先让动作专家学会执行这些指令，再通过闭环强化学习（RL）联合优化 VLM 的移动决策和动作专家在连续环境中的执行。在使用相同导航回合训练的条件下，ZeroVLN 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上显著优于代表性的基于 SFT 的分层导航方法，同时仅小幅改变 VLM 权重，基本保留其通用能力。
key_points_zh: 以自然语言移动指令替代几何目标预测：慢速 VLM 负责决策，快速动作专家负责执行。
先适配动作专家，再用闭环 RL 联合优化快慢策略；不做导航领域 SFT 并不意味着冻结 VLM。
在相同导航回合下训练，ZeroVLN 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上显著优于代表性的 SFT 分层方法，同时仅小幅更新 VLM 权重，基本保留其通用能力。
